QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GCC-style (`__GNUC__`) or ARMCC (`library/constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is set by MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros (`__GNUC__`/ARMCC) in constant_time_impl.h. That shows it is derived, not set in a config entry. It never says "not in mbedtls_config.h" outright, but the derivation is stated.
